e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.1.evidence: LearnDash activated; Settings > Integrations: 'auto create space' for LearnDash ticked, type Forum, Save Settings (persists). Published course 'Introduction to WordPress Plugin Development' (WP-CLI post create, sfwd-courses) -> exactly one space (id 238) titled like the course, type forum, visibility private, plus access rule membership ld_course_65 grants participate, role member. Visibility is not a setting on that tab (always private).

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.2.evidence: Course set to draft, then republished, content edited, title re-saved: still exactly 1 space and 1 access rule for ld_course_65.

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.3.evidence: alice enrolled (ld_update_course_access): space opens (REST 200, 'You have access through <course>', 2 members), she posted a topic; the LearnDash course page /courses/introduction-to-wordpress-plugin-development/ shows a 'Course discussion' link to /community/s/introduction-to-wordpress-plugin-development/. Screenshot lms-course-alice.png.

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.4.evidence: bob (not enrolled): search /community/search/?q=Introduction... lists the space card; opening /community/s/<slug>/ shows only the locked teaser 'Included with Introduction to WordPress Plugin Development (Course). You get access as soon as you join...' with a 'Get <course>' link and no topics (PASS parts). REST GET /spaces?per_page=100 as bob DOES list space 238 (is_member:false, visibility private); the check says REST /spaces does not list it. The wave-3 ruling ('private spaces are listed to members as locked previews') suggests the check line is out of date. The /community/spaces/ directory URL used here did not contain it (the page may paginate); My Spaces link not located. Guests do not get it in REST.

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.5.evidence: alice posted a topic in the course space, then ld_update_course_access(remove): GET /spaces/238 -> 403 at once, her membership row gone, her topic still there (1); re-enrol: 200 member and the topic is listed again.

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.6.evidence: Course to draft: space 238 stays active and private, the rule is kept and the Access Rules screen flags it 'Course no longer available - It was deleted, trashed or unpublished, so nobody can get it and this rule lets nobody in. Publish it again or delete this rule.'; alice gets 403. Republish: still 1 space and 1 rule. Force-deleting the course also left the space active with its rule. (A brand-new course with the same title is a different level and gets its own space, as expected.)

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.7.evidence: No bulk 'create spaces for existing courses' action exists in Settings > Integrations or the Pro CLI (searched), so there is nothing to run twice; idempotence of provisioning itself was shown in check 2. Recorded as not offered.

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.8.evidence: Learnomy inactive, admin POST /learnomy/course-discussion -> 400 'Learnomy is not active.'. With Learnomy 1.8.0 active and a course row owned by test_author: test_editor on that course -> 403 jetonomy_pro_forbidden_course 'You can only change courses you own.'; admin on course 999999 -> 404 'That course could not be found.'; guest 401. BUT the real owner (test_author) enabling the discussion on their own published course -> 500 critical error: PHP Fatal 'Undefined constant Learnomy\Models\Course::HIDDEN_VISIBILITIES' in jetonomy-pro class-learnomy-integration.php:1309 (space_visibility, called from create_space_for_course). Product bug: Pro 2.0.7 is incompatible with Learnomy 1.8.0 on this path. Learnomy deactivated afterwards.

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.9.evidence: Uncanny Automator (free) active; built a recipe through its own REST builder (trigger: 'A user's role in any space changes', actions added with item/action/add). Recipe live; promoting/demoting test_editor in Troubleshooting fired it: 'Add the user to Off-Topic Lounge' -> test_editor became a member of space 17, recipe log completed; 'Change the user's role in Off-Topic Lounge to Moderator' -> role moderator; 'Remove the user from Off-Topic Lounge' -> row removed; each recipe-log row completed=1. (Automator needed all other heavy plugins off: activating it with LearnDash and PMPro hit the 128M PHP memory limit; environment.)

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.10.evidence: The 'role changed' trigger: 4 consecutive role changes of test_editor in Troubleshooting (member, admin, member, admin) each produced exactly +1 recipe-log row. Observation: one change made right after I edited the recipe produced 2 log rows with the same timestamp (IDs 2 and 3) and was not reproducible in 6 further changes.

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.11.evidence: Action 'Change role' with role superadmin -> recipe log 'completed with errors' (completed=2), Automator error log: 'Invalid role. Allowed: viewer, member, moderator, admin.', role unchanged. Action 'Add the user to space 99999' -> completed with errors, error log 'That space no longer exists.', no row created. Note: 'Remove the user from space 99999' is logged as plain Completed (nothing to remove). A role above the rule's role cannot be expressed in the recipe UI, so only the invalid-role case was run.

e-lms-course-spaces-and-automator.12.evidence: Course with a 96-character title: the space page at 390px has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390) and the title wraps within the 96-346px column (screenshot lms-space-390-light.png). Dark mode via the Reign toggle was verified on the locked-teaser component of the same course/space family (dark cards and tokens), not repeated for this exact enrolled header.
